prompt: A friend who has just started a small tutoring business asks you to post a glowing five-star review online, even though you have never actually used their tutoring. They say everyone does it when starting out. What is the most supportive and honest response?

options.text: Post the review as they wrote it, because helping a friend get started matters more than one review
Post a vague three-star review instead, so it looks balanced and nobody is really misled
Ignore the request and hope they forget they asked you
Decline to fake a review, but offer real help instead: try a session so you can review honestly, share their page, or give feedback on their advert

explanation: A fake review misleads strangers who are trusting it with their money, but refusing does not have to mean refusing to help. Trying the service, sharing it or improving the advert supports your friend in ways that are actually true.
